name: aritii-market
description: Aritii Market — API Gateway, Identity, Commerce and Delivery services in one repository. This root manifest owns no runtime dependency: it exists so the whole platform can be linted, tested and brought up with one command, and so CI has a single entry point.

scripts.test: npm run test:architecture && npm run test:gateway && npm run test:services
scripts.test:services: npm --prefix identity-service test && npm --prefix commerce-service test && npm --prefix delivery-service test
